description: The Supercycle Convertible Trike is a versatile ride that grows with your kids. It transforms into four modes: push stroller, push trike, training trike, and classic trike. It features a removable, foldable canopy for UV protection, a comfortable, detachable seat cushion, a storage basket, and a front fender to keep mud away. This versatile trike offers safety and convenience as your child grows.

components.description: Storage basket for little things, like drinks, toys, small balls
Front wheel clutch to release or limit the foot pedal according to the needs
Inflatable-free light wheels have shock absorption structure
Has a removable and foldable canopy for UV protection
Height adjustable push handle can control tricycle movement
Comfortable seat cushion, detachable for daily clean and maintain
Safety guardrail and 5-points safety harness, to ensure the safe using
It can be transformed into four modes of use: push stroller, push trike, training trike and classic trike, grow with your kids
Front wheel has a fender to keeps the muddy water out
